title: Public Creator Vanity Project List
summary: Render the already-authorized anonymous public project collection on the existing public creator vanity page without expanding identity, media, rights, or mutation boundaries.
resolution: Resolve the existing public creator profile first.
Preserve the existing creator-profile 404 and 503 behavior.
Only after successful creator resolution, resolve the public creator project collection by the canonical resolved handle.
Require the collection canonical handle to equal the resolved profile canonical handle.
Treat collection unavailable, not-found after successful profile resolution, invalid-input, or handle disagreement as page 503.
Do not perform any private-project filtering in the page.
projectIdPolicy: The collection may contain the public project identifier, but the vanity page does not render it because no public project page is introduced by this step.
preservedBoundaries: Canonical vanity URL derives from the canonical resolved creator handle.
No PrincipalId or SeshCreatorId is rendered or composed.
No project lifecycle or graph metadata is rendered.
No handle availability behavior is introduced.
Public presentation grants no copyright, master, composition, publishing, distribution, management, label, royalty, licensing, revenue, collaborator, legal, or account rights.
scope: No public project detail page is introduced.
No public project link is invented.
No migration is authored or executed.
